name: Wyatt
description:
Connects Claude to your Wyatt workspace over Wyatt's remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in — no API keys to paste.

Claude can search and read workspace documents, create and safely edit markdown docs, browse tasks and prioritized next actions, and kick off background Wyatt agents for durable asynchronous work. 

Includes three skills (workspace orientation, document work, task management) that teach Claude the right workflows, plus a /wyatt command that connects and catches you up on your workspace in one step.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wyatt to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wyatt to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.wyattworks.ai/api/mcp-server. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wyatt MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wyatt lists 13 MCP tools, including create_document, delete_document, get_connection_info, get_document, get_task, get_workspace_context_next, get_workspace_overview, kickoff_background_agent, list_documents, list_tasks, list_workspaces, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wyatt?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Wyatt in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Wyatt requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Wyatt is developed by Lumin. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
